source.title: Kazakhstan Today, 23.06.2026: ITU OB No. 1341 assigned +7 0, +7 6, +7 7 to Kazakhstan
Forbes.kz: Kazakhtelecom completed sale of Mobile Telecom-Service (Tele2/Altel) to PIH Communication (Power International Holding, Qatar), 14.01.2025
finratings.kz: 8 (800) 080-77-77 eGov contact centre added to emergency/special services list (Government resolution of 30.07.2025)

nationalNumber.structure: NDC (3 digits: ABC geographic or DEF non-geographic) + subscriber number (7 digits); for geographic numbers the 7 digits begin with a locality code, so the effective dialled 'area code' is 4–5 digits (e.g. 7172 + 6, 72772 + 5) except Almaty (727 + 7)
nationalNumber.internationalFormat: +7 NDC XXXXXXX (11 digits incl. country code)
nationalNumber.domesticInternationalPrefix: 8~10 (per Wikipedia; not confirmed in ITU text)
nationalNumber.source: itu-nnp-kz (Communication of 1.VI.2022: 'The international number consists of eleven (11) digits'; 2006: '+7 ABC X1..X7', '+7 DEF X1..X7'); kz-order-307: national number 'содержащий 10 десятичных знаков' (3-digit ABC/DEF/КДУ + 7-digit subscriber)

countryRanges.agreement: Agreement between the Government of the Republic of Kazakhstan and the Government of the Russian Federation on the joint use of numbering for world numbering zone 7; in force 3 December 2025, indefinite, 24-month termination notice. Replaces the 2006 agreement between communications administrations.
countryRanges.sharedRule: Each party assigns codes in shared ranges independently under national law and uses them only inside its own national network — i.e. a +7 1xx / +7 800-809 / +7 881-899 number cannot be attributed to KZ or RU by prefix alone.

otherNonGeographic.use: VoIP access codes; international access not available
Office of the Prime Minister of the Republic of Kazakhstan

countryRanges.source: itu-ob-1341 (table read from PDF column coordinates: col1 'exclusive use of the Russian Federation', col2 'exclusive use of the Republic of Kazakhstan', col3 'shared'); itu-nnp-kz

mobile.brand: Altel (listed by ITU as 'Mobile network CDMA')

mobile.confidence: high (operator); medium (brand split Kcell vs Activ not in primary source)

mobileNotes: Mobile number portability exists in KZ: the DEF code identifies the original (issuing) operator only.
Mobile Telecom-Service (Tele2 + Altel) was sold by Kazakhtelecom to PIH Communication LLC (Power International Holding, Qatar) on 14.01.2025 (source: mts-sale-2025).

No evidence found of any new mobile DEF code (703, 704, 709, 772-774, 779 etc.) assigned 2022–2026; the ITU KZ plan updated 2026-06-30 still carries the 2022 list. Telecom Committee reportedly said no new mobile operator before end of 2026 (inform.kz, page returned 403, seen only in search snippet).

itu-nnp-kz lists 'Qapshagai 727 72' (Almaty Area); rename Qapshagai→Konaev and status as regional centre are NOT in the ITU text

landline.region: область Жетісу (центр с 2022; в плане ITU 2022 — центр Алматинской области)
область Абай (центр с 2022; в плане ITU 2022 — 'East Kazakhstan Area (former Semei area)')
область Ұлытау (центр с 2022; в плане ITU 2022 — 'Qaragandy Area (part joined from former Zhezqazgan area)')

landlineNotes: ABC (3-digit) zone codes in 2022 KZ plan: 710 (Zhezkazgan/Ulytau part), 711 West Kaz., 712 Atyrau, 713 Aktobe, 714 Kostanay, 715 North Kaz., 716 Akmola, 717 Astana, 718 Pavlodar, 721 Karaganda, 722 Semey/Abai, 723 East Kaz., 724 Kyzylorda, 725 Shymkent+Turkistan, 726 Zhambyl, 727 Almaty city + parts of Almaty region, 728 Taldykorgan/Zhetisu, 729 Mangystau.
Within an ABC zone the locality code is 1 digit (6-digit subscriber) for the centre or 2 digits (5-digit subscriber) for district localities; ABC + locality + subscriber always = 10 digits.
ITU 2022 table has typos: Atbasar shown as '+7 316 43', Ekibastuz '+7 318 7/35', Toqty '718 44' dialled '718 43'. Do not copy dialling-format column blindly.

special.freephone: Kazakhstan uses 8 800 XXX XXXX freephone (e.g. eGov 8 (800) 080-77-77). Under the 2025 agreement 800-809 is a SHARED range: each country uses it only in its own national network, so +7 800… is not internationally routable and cannot be attributed to KZ vs RU by prefix.
special.shortNumbers: Short codes (101–104, 112, 1414, 1484 etc.) are not E.164 numbers — do not treat as valid national numbers.
special.nonMobileNonGeoKZ: 750 (dial-up), 751 (VoIP, no international access), 753 (PM Office), 760, 763, 790 (corporate/satellite) — valid KZ ranges but not mobile and not geographic.
special.confidence: high (range rules); medium (8 800 usage in KZ — news source only)
